self_report: Understands a lot of Russian and knows many words passively, learned mostly by ear. Has rarely written Russian and spells words the way he pronounces them. Struggles with grammar (endings, cases) and with expressing himself in speaking and writing.
goals: Speak and write Russian accurately and with confidence
Control case endings and verb aspect in real sentences
Close the gap between what he understands and what he can say

overall.note: Placement in progress: grammar test (2026-11-08) and writing sample (2026-11-09) done. Speaking sample and one reading still to come.

writing.evidence: Writing sample 2026-11-09 (w-a2-01, 79 words): a connected story with connectors (но, поэтому), feelings and a sequence of events; some B1 vocabulary (дешевле, пригласил, проверить). 45 errors = 57 per 100 words: 22 spelling, 20 grammar (25 per 100 words: accusative objects and time phrases, dative, agreement, numbers), 3 word choice. Meaning clear throughout except one phrase. A2 task fulfilment with A2-bottom accuracy; one sample only.

grammar.evidence: Placement 2026-11-08, raw: A1 6/11 (55%), A2 4/11 (36%), B1 2/11 (18%), B2 1/11. Counting 5 spelling-only errors as grammar-correct: A1 8/11 (73%), A2 4/11, B1 5/11 (45%). Below the 75% bar even at A1, so no level recorded yet. Patchy profile: some B1 structures known (чтобы + past, prefixed motion verbs, -ами), basic singular endings and agreement not yet reliable. Writing sample 2026-11-09: masculine past (болел, купил, пригласил) and perfective after надо (прочитать, проверить) right; endings on objects mostly missing (мой школьная работа, пригласил они), plural agreement wrong (они был).

vocabulary.evidence: Active everyday vocabulary is solid in translations and the writing sample (пригласил, дешевле, сразу, проверить, костюмы, ресторан); some word-choice slips (тоже for 'also', обед for an evening meal). Not measured in reading yet.

weak_points.label: Writes by ear: unstressed о→а, е→и, ё→о, missing ь (-шь, фильм), ы/и, не + verb joined
Accusative for objects and time phrases (кого? что? когда?)
Dative: кому? (писать, звонить, помогать) and after благодаря
Genitive after нет / много, and for people in the plural
Agreement with the subject: past tense gender, мне понравился / понравилась
Numbers with nouns: 2–4 + genitive singular; евро never changes
Instrumental after с; prepositional of -ия nouns and city names
Aspect: process vs one result (past), когда + perfective future
тоже (too, same as someone) vs ещё / также (also, in addition)

strengths: Understands a lot and has a useful active vocabulary for everyday topics
Tells a connected story with connectors (но, поэтому), feelings and reasons
Already uses key patterns: мне нравится, у неё (есть), с + instrumental, чтобы + past
Masculine past tense and common perfective verbs mostly right (купил, пригласил, проверить)

plan.next_session: Placement, part 3: a 5–10 minute speaking sample in voice mode (Practice → Speaking, e.g. 'Weekend plans' or 'About yourself'), plus the A2 reading 'Выходные без телефона' in the Read tab and a copied report. Then set first levels and start lessons: 1) Spelling sheet and test, 2) accusative for objects and time, 3) dative (кому?).

milestones.goal: Retake the placement test: A1 items at 85%+ and A2 items at 75%+

history.summary: Russian Coach set up: app, starter deck, grammar sheets, tests and readings. No assessment yet.

Placement part 1 (grammar test): 13/44 objective (30%); A1 6/11, A2 4/11, B1 2/11, B2 1/11. Five errors were spelling-only, so the adjusted scores are A1 73%, B1 45%. Translations: meaning clear in 3 of 4, about 60 errors per 100 words, half of them spelling.

Placement part 2 (writing sample, A2 prompt, 79 words): connected story with A2 task fulfilment; 57 errors per 100 words (22 spelling, 20 grammar, 3 word choice). Initial writing level A2, low confidence. +15 cards.
